name: @ai-ecoverse/cloudflare
description: The cf-ext CLI for jsh: Cloudflare zone analytics and invoices, spend and contract numbers from a logged-in dash.cloudflare.com tab, which Cloudflare's own cf CLI cannot reach. Everything else in the skill uses cf. `pnpm add` it in /opt/user on SLICC 7, or `npm install -g` this folder to put `cf-ext` on PATH.
